question: Which statement most precisely captures the additivity property of electric charge for a system partitioned into parts with charges $q_1, q_2, \dots, q_n$ (with signs)?

options.A: The net charge equals the algebraic sum: $Q_{total} = \sum q_i$.
options.B: The net charge equals the sum of magnitudes: $Q_{total} = \sum |q_i|$.
options.C: The net charge depends on how the system is partitioned into parts.
options.D: The net charge depends on the distances among the parts.
